name: User settings
descr: The settings the people of the shop change themselves: the groups in a tree, and in every group the settings with the mask their text is typed by, plus the rights that say who sees a group. What the storefront reads out of them is the business of the modules.

commands.name: CmdList
commands.descr: Reads the whole tree of the groups, the rights on them and every setting in them - three tables.

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Adds a group under a parent, or at the top of the tree when parent_id is 0.

params.name: parent_id
params.descr: id of the group it goes under; 0 puts it at the top of the tree

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the group

params.name: folder
params.descr: true - a folder that only groups others

commands.name: CmdUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of groups, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the group, or several of them

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the group

params.name: folder
params.descr: true - a folder that only groups others

commands.name: CmdMove
commands.descr: Moves a group under another parent, with its branch.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the group to move

params.name: parent_id
params.descr: id of the group it goes under; 0 puts it at the top of the tree

commands.name: CmdRemove
commands.descr: Deletes groups by id, with the branch under them, the settings in them and the rights on them. The first call counts what goes, the second one does it.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the group, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the settings and the rights standing in these groups go with them, and the modules that read those settings will find nothing; without it such a deletion is refused

commands.name: CmdValueAdd
commands.descr: Adds a setting to a group, at the end of its list.

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the group the setting goes into

params.name: code
params.descr: the code of the setting, the word a module reads it by

params.name: prefix
params.descr: the prefix shown before the field

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the setting

params.name: descr
params.descr: what it is for, as the people of the shop read it

params.name: mask_edit
params.descr: the mask the text is typed by

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the text of the setting itself

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list; left out, it goes to the end

commands.name: CmdValueUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of settings, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the setting, or several of them

params.name: code
params.descr: the code of the setting, the word a module reads it by

params.name: prefix
params.descr: the prefix shown before the field

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the setting

params.name: descr
params.descr: what it is for, as the people of the shop read it

params.name: mask_edit
params.descr: the mask the text is typed by

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the text of the setting itself

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list

commands.name: CmdValueRemove
commands.descr: Deletes settings by id. The group they stood in stays.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the setting, or several of them

commands.name: CmdValuePos
commands.descr: Lays the settings of one group in order.

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the group whose settings are put in order

params.name: type
params.descr: POS - the rows given go to the front in that order; MOVE - one row shifts by so many places, minus upwards; SORT - the whole list is laid out by a column

params.name: data
params.descr: the payload of that type: [{"id": 22}] for POS, [{"id": 22, "inc": -5}] for MOVE - inc is how many places it shifts, minus upwards - and {"field": "name", "direction": "ASC"} for SORT

commands.name: CmdRightAdd
commands.descr: Grants the sight of groups, to a person or to a group of people: one row of self_key_right on each of them. One of user_id and group_id, never both.

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the group, or several of them

params.name: user_id
params.descr: id of the person who sees the group

params.name: group_id
params.descr: id of the group of people who see it

commands.name: CmdRightUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of the rows of self_key_right, by id - CmdList answers them with their ids.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of self_key_right, or several of them

params.name: user_id
params.descr: id of the person who sees the group

params.name: group_id
params.descr: id of the group of people who see it

commands.name: CmdRightRemove
commands.descr: Deletes the rows of self_key_right by id. A group with no rights on it is seen by nobody.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of self_key_right, or several of them
